== Merge with PMT (October 2026) ==
* Merged [[PMT]] (2012 Match Play Championship Day 1, pages 94–95 of the Day 1 PDF) into this page. The 2012 sheets are signed "PMT" with no username; the DS deck is named "PMJ's ASM" in the same hand, and his J has a top bar that reads as T. The same misreading appears on his 2009 Yavin 4 sheets (name "PMT", username "Pat MyT" for "Pat My J"), which were already credited here, and his 2011 MPC sheet is signed "PMJ" in the same print. Bill confirmed Patrick Johnson goes by PMJ. [[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 21:23, 31 October 2026 (UTC)
